description: This file declares functions for validating various radio network configurations related to serving cell parameters, including PDCCH, PDSCH, PUCCH, PUSCH, SRS, NZP-CSI-RS, and CSI-MeasConfig, within the ocudu namespace.

methods.name: validate_pdcch_cfg
methods.description: Validates PDCCH configuration in the UE serving cell config and DL common config.

methods.name: validate_pdsch_cfg
methods.description: Validates PDSCH configuration in the UE serving cell config.

methods.name: validate_pucch_cfg
methods.description: Validates PUCCH configuration with resource list, common config, and number of DL antennas.

methods.name: validate_pusch_cfg
methods.description: Validates PUSCH uplink configuration, considering CSI enablement.

methods.name: validate_srs_cfg
methods.description: Validates SRS configuration with UE serving cell config and UL BWP CRB interval.

methods.name: validate_nzp_csi_rs_list
methods.description: Validates NZP-CSI-RS resource list with optional TDD configuration.

methods.name: validate_csi_meas_cfg
methods.description: Validates CSI measurement configuration with optional TDD config and UL common config.
